prompts.hero: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: square Alibaba B2B search hero. Input image 1 is the exact edit target, Luqi 2633 OffWhite shoe pair. Replace only the cupboard, wood floor and room background with a seamless clean white studio backdrop; remove all props. Preserve both photographed shoes exactly: same off-white mesh holes, thin black side cords, toe proportions, gum brown scalloped outsole and tread edges, lace eyelets, elastic drawcord, plastic toggle and central rectangular keeper, heel pull loops, perspective and pair relationship. Keep complete toe, heel and pull tabs in frame, high product occupancy about 85%, natural lighting, at most faint contact shadows below soles. Do not redesign or redraw product geometry; no new views, no conventional bow laces, no added panels, no color changes, no halo, no text, badges, watermark or performance graphics.
prompts.options_v1: Use case: compositing. Asset type: square Alibaba B2B gallery color and EU size selection panel. Input image 1 is Luqi 2633 OffWhite with gum-brown sole; input image 2 is exact Black with all-black sole on feet; input image 3 is exact LightGrey with black sole on feet. Create a restrained white-background international footwear procurement layout using THREE photographic panels from these exact inputs. Preserve the photographed shoe pixels, mesh, drawcord toggle, shape, colors and outsole design; use the available views as photographed and retain enough original context so no hidden shoe part needs invention. Label each source panel accurately: image 2 "Black", image 3 "Light Grey", image 1 "Off White". Header exactly "COLOR & EU SIZE OPTIONS". Lower line exactly "EU 39-48". Small footer exactly "Send your color-size mix for a quotation". Clean dark charcoal typography, large recognizable shoes, modest spacing, no fake color variants, no US conversions or foot-length table, no pricing, no stock claim, no OEM promise, no logos or certification icons. Avoid repeating a single color image three times. Preserve SKU identity over stylistic uniformity.
prompts.options_v2: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the edit target, a color-size panel. Inputs 2, 3, 4 are the original photographic inserts for Off White, Black and Light Grey respectively. Fix ONLY the cropping/layout. Replace the three tall cropped photo panels with three equal SQUARE photo panels in one row, each displaying its corresponding ENTIRE original square photograph uncropped, fitted inside without modifying any photographed pixel content or inventing shoe parts. Every shoe toe, sole and heel visible in each original must remain visible. Leave normal white margins. Keep all existing exact header, labels, EU 39-48 line and quotation footer unchanged. Black is original input 3, Light Grey original input 4, Off White original input 2. Do not retouch, reconstruct or alter the shoe; no extra colors, no new views. This is a photo-layout correction only. Shrink inserts if needed so all source photographs fit square frames without any crop.
prompts.structure: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: square Alibaba product gallery structure evidence for Luqi 2633. Input image is the exact photographed shoe. Make a clean white-background close-up layout using only the FRONT shoe from this photograph, focusing on its open mesh toe and the existing thin black side cords. Keep the visible mesh hole pattern, off-white color, toe overlay seam, gum sole edge, drawcord eyelets and toggle hardware EXACTLY as photographed; crop from the existing view without inventing unseen surfaces. The product region should occupy most of the image and resolve mesh, stitching and panel construction. Use only the exact modest header "OPEN MESH UPPER" and small bottom label "Toe and side-panel construction". No arrows, wind, breathability test, magnification numbers, fiber composition, comfort or medical claims. No extra logos, parts, shine, stock or certification. This must be faithful photographic cropping/background cleanup and readable typography, not a redesigned shoe.
prompts.enquiry: Use case: compositing. Asset type: square Alibaba B2B product-gallery enquiry-input panel, Luqi 2633. Input image 1 is the exact source photograph. Build a restrained clean white layout with the unchanged COMPLETE photographed front off-white shoe on the left occupying roughly half the canvas, retaining its mesh, thin black side cords, gum brown scalloped outsole, toe shape, elastic drawcord toggle, keeper and heel loop. It must remain the same shoe and same view; remove only room/wood props. On the right a short legible enquiry checklist: header exactly "PLAN YOUR WHOLESALE ENQUIRY"; lines exactly "Color + EU size mix", "Pair quantity", "Packaging needs", "Destination". Modest footer exactly "Availability and terms confirmed for your order". Product photo must remain prominent and intact, use neutral charcoal text, no cards with prices, no icons or decorative badges, no stock guarantee, no customized production promise, no other products or company-source disclosures. The visual answers which inputs a B2B buyer should send for a quote. No new colors, no material or performance claims, no text-only filler.

review.hero: ACCEPT: complete photographed shoe pair, matching mesh/cords/closure/gum sole, white background, no obvious structural drift at displayed resolution.
review.structure: ACCEPT: visible source toe/mesh/cord closure in a clear construction crop; no quantified property claimed. Not physical inspection or microscopic material proof.
review.options_v1: REJECT: tall photo panels cut additional shoe regions.
review.options_v2: ACCEPT: same three source variants and EU39-48; preserves source views; no conversion/foot length/stock promises.
review.enquiry: ACCEPT: same front shoe, four real buyer inputs, no unsupported MOQ/OEM/delivery guarantees.

limits: Visual comparison only; not physical product or performance proof. Raw source remains read-only. Other product galleries and detail upgrades remain pending.
